The Ministry of Home Affairs, exercising the power vested under Section 58, sub-section (a) of the
Registration of Associations Law, and with the consent of the Union Government, hereby issues these
Rules.
Chapter (1)
Title and Definition
1. These Rules shall be called the Registration of Associations Rules.
2. The expressions contained in these Rules shall have the meanings assigned to them in the
Registration of Associations Law. Furthermore, the following expressions shall have the meanings
assigned below:
(a) Law means the Registration of Associations Law.
(b) Temporary Registration Certificate means a certificate issued by the relevant
Registration Board to allow an association to temporarily carry out its objectives and
activities pending the scrutiny of the application for a Registration Certificate in
accordance with the law.
(c) Renewed Registration Certificate means a certificate issued by the relevant Registration
Board after scrutiny in accordance with the law, permitting an association to continue to
exist and operate after the expiry of its Registration Certificate.
(d) Recommendation means evidence from the relevant government department or
organization endorsing that the objectives and activities to be implemented by the
association align with policies and goals, and can genuinely contribute to the
department's work, other than an implicit statement of support.

(f) Annual Report means a report prepared in accordance with financial rules and
regulations, detailing the activities of the association consistent with its objectives and
activities over a one-year period, submitted to the relevant Registration Board.
(g) Financial Statement means the accounts from Form (15) to Form (15-h), audited in

(h) Association Property (or Assets) means funds, reserves, debts, debentures, social stocks,
bonds, bank accounts, intellectual property rights, or property acquired by the association
through donations or purchased with the association's funds.
(i) Property (or Assets) means movable or immovable property, and this expression includes
tangible or intangible property.
(j) Financial Intelligence Unit means the Financial Intelligence Unit established under the
Anti-Money Laundering Law.
(k) Form means a form prescribed under these Rules.
Chapter (2)
Duties of the Registration Boards at the Various Levels
3. The Registration Boards at the various levels may, in implementing the duties mentioned in
Section 6 of the Law, carry out the following:
(a) Scrutinize whether the use of the association's name, stamp, mark, and uniform design
complies with Section 28, sub-section (b) of the Law;
(b) Scrutinize whether the association is carrying out its objectives and activities and whether
it is exceeding them;

branches in accordance with the prescribed regulations;
(e) Scrutinize and record the association's activities that conflict with any existing law, and if
there are suspicious circumstances, send information to the relevant government

accordance with the Risk Assessment Report on Terrorism Financing concerning Non-
Profit Organizations (NPOs) issued by the Anti-Money Laundering Central Body;
(f) Exercise hierarchical supervision and mutual sharing of information between Registration

Chapter (3)
Registration and Renewal of Domestic Associations
4. A Domestic Association, to obtain a Registration Certificate, shall apply to the relevant
Registration Board in accordance with Section 7 of the Law, with a completed Form (1), attaching
complete required information. In such application, a copy of a bank book showing the following
minimum initial funds, opened in the names of at least two responsible officers of the association,
must be presented: 100 million Kyats (1,000 Lakhs) if applying to the Union Registration Board; or
50 million Kyats (500 Lakhs) if applying to a Region, State, or Union Territory Registration Board.
5. If the relevant Registration Board receives an application under Rule 4, it shall issue a Domestic
Association Temporary Registration Certificate using Form (3) within 21 days, excluding
government holidays, from the date of application.
6. The relevant Registration Board shall send the personal information of the executive members of
the Domestic Association for which Form (3) has been issued to the Myanmar Police Force to
verify whether they meet the following qualifications:
(a) Being a citizen, associate citizen, or naturalized citizen of Myanmar;
(b) Being at least 18 years of age;
(c) Not being a member of a political party;

7. The relevant Registration Board:

following factors and decide whether to permit registration as a Domestic Association:
(1) The application does not potentially undermine the State's sovereignty, rule of
law, security, or national unity;
(2) The information in the application conforms with the provisions of the law;
(3) The application aligns with State policies or existing laws;
(4) The activities are beneficial to the State and its citizens;
(5) The activities do not potentially have adverse effects on any or all social activities;
(6) The stated objectives and activities are related to the policies and goals of the
government department or organization that provided the recommendation, or
can support the work of that organization;
(7) The activities do not potentially interfere with domestic affairs or politics of the
State;
(8) The activities do not involve actions that could affect foreign investments;
